title: Combining Choice and Response Time Data: A Drift-Diffusion Model of Mobile Advertisements
eligible_reason: No DiD or event study. The package estimates a two-stage drift-diffusion model of click-through and response time by simulated nonlinear least squares with a neural-network surrogate (ddm_sim_dict.ipynb, ddm_NLS.ipynb, ddm_simulated_likelihood.ipynb). There is no treatment indicator, panel, or fixed-effects regression; the only statsmodels import is incidental. The ft_callaway flag is a false positive.
design_notes: Field data on user responses to mobile video ads: (y_i, t_i) click and response time per user plus synthetic covariates (readme.html: covariates z-scored with N(0,1) noise added). GPU/Colab Python notebooks.
data_files: click_response_dist.csv (2 MB; choices and response times)
screener_notes: Screened from package only (readme.html, grep of notebooks).
